verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a system-on-chip, a hardware component with no user-facing command interface, so operating it with natural-language commands is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence that Apple Intelligence models run fast on it describes OS and software features running on the chip, which are host-platform capabilities rather than a natural-language interface the chip itself provides.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
